svg.desc:
@startuml FIG-CL-TAV-09 skinparam shadowing false title FIG-CL-TAV-09 Experiment architecture
SysML 1.6 notation-based views; executable/metamodel conformance is not claimed
evaluator-only truth is never an algorithm input
rectangle "Controlled scene / config
(IUT, fault plan, resource mode)" as Scene rectangle "Independent truth record
(evaluator only)" as Truth rectangle "Comparison arms
CL-T / CL-A / CL-TA / CL-LOOP" as Arms rectangle "Observations and resource log
(algorithm-visible)" as Obs rectangle "Validity check
(invalid, equivalent, missing)" as Valid rectangle "Metrics with denominators
EXP-CLTAV-DETECT / LOCATE / ABLATION" as Metrics rectangle "RQ / claims
(no unrun numbers)" as Claims
Scene --> Arms : same declared pool and action library Scene --> Truth : injection plan + execution confirmation Truth -[#red,dashed]-> Arms : forbidden leakage Arms --> Obs : algorithm-visible Izk, q, cost Obs --> Valid Truth --> Valid : evaluator-only confirmation Valid --> Metrics : attempt and answered-subset denominators Metrics --> Claims : comparable projections only
note right of Truth Evaluator truth must not enter IF-SELECT-ADMIT, IF-PRED-OBS, IF-HIST-UPDATE or IF-EXECUTE-RECORD. IF-OBS-INTERPRET, IF-PREP-RECOVER, IF-EQUIV and IF-RESOURCE-STOP stay algorithm-visible only. Experiment I/O: IF-EXP-SCENE, IF-EXP-INJECT, IF-EXP-TRUTH, IF-EXP-COLLECT, IF-EXP-RUN, IF-EXP-FILTER, IF-EXP-EVAL. end note note bottom of Arms Same pool is not a gift of later CL-LOOP records to other arms, and not a fictional sampling charge to CL-A. Groups: EXP-CLTAV-DETECT, EXP-CLTAV-LOCATE, EXP-CLTAV-ABLATION. end note @enduml
svg.text: SysML 1.6 notation-based views; executable/metamodel conformance is not claimed
Comparison arms CL-T / CL-A / CL-TA / CL-LOOP
IF-SELECT-ADMIT IF-PRED-OBS IF-HIST-UPDATE IF-EXECUTE-RECORD never take truth
